alert_semantics: An alert is an operational interpretation of persisted model or detector output, not a confirmed failure.
automatic_resolution_policy: New alerts use status=open. Automatic resolution is outside this phase.
drift_fleet_alert_decision: The current alerts table requires machine_id, while drift monitoring is population-level state. Drift is exposed through /api/v1/drift/latest instead.
idempotency_policy: Repeated execution reuses existing identical source-derived alerts.
score_policy: AI4I and anomaly scores are never combined by this alert policy.
